name: Blood Orange, Pink Grapefruit & Rooibos
desc: Tart winter-to-spring citrus with rooibos's rounded tea character.
ing: 200 g blood orange flesh, peeled and de-pithed
170 g pink grapefruit flesh, white pith and pips removed
200 ml chilled unsweetened rooibos tea, cold-brewed in the fridge
Water, as needed to reach 800–850 ml TOTAL volume in jug (not extra)
method: Wash and prepare all fresh fruit. Remove bitter citrus pith and pips, and peel and deseed melon as specified.
Add ingredients to the 1-litre soup maker and top up with chilled water only as necessary for 800–850 ml TOTAL contents; stay within 800 ml MIN and 1,000 ml MAX.
Blend on the UNHEATED Drinks/Blend programme for approximately 2 minutes.
Drink cool and fresh; add no sugar unless absolutely necessary to balance unusually sour fruit.
science: Whole citrus and melon contribute water and various vitamins; no nutrition totals have yet been calculated.
note: Project 400 · Citrus, melon & refreshment · ££ · Spring · Untested idea. ID P400-077.
